Original Decipher card face for [[Colo Claw Fish (Dark)]] (Reflections III), as shown in the card list on Decipher's own website.

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/reflections3/dark/images/coloclawfish.jpg coloclawfish.jpg], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020411051020/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/reflections3/dark/images/coloclawfish.jpg Internet Archive], 11 April 2002. SHA-256 of the archived file: 189d2f97ea5c61c31c8e24fcaf21f546e294e21d5c2bf16b932c5938dba8db49.

Edits: none. The file is the archived JPG byte for byte.

This replaces [[:File:Ref3-D-coloclawfish-pc2007.gif]] (formerly misnamed ReflectionsIII-D-coloclawfish-decipher-archive.gif), which is a Players Committee copy, not Decipher's scan. The PC Holotable face is [[:File:Ref3-D-coloclawfish.gif]] and is not replaced by this file.
